items.title: Spot Natural Gas Gives Autumn’s Chill the Cold Shoulder
items.summary: A touch of autumn chill offered little support for natural gas cash prices Thursday, with eastern markets posting steep declines despite cooler forecasts and Midwest prices weakening amid unseasonable warmth and comfortable storage inventories.

items.title: Natural Gas Forwards Sink as Mild Weather Masks Bullish Longer-Term Signals
items.summary: The forward curve is being dragged down by weak weather forecasts and resilient natural gas production as winter nears, despite some longer-term bullish signals that could send prices higher in some parts of the country.

items.title: Seasonally Light Storage Build Gives Natural Gas Futures Ground to Stand On
items.summary: Natural gas futures on the New York Mercantile Exchange advanced at midday as traders digested a bullish inventory result.

items.title: Cheniere Inks Long-Term LNG Deal With QatarEnergy
items.summary: QatarEnergy has agreed to purchase 4 Mt/y of LNG from Cheniere Energy through 2054, expanding its ties to US export supplies as damage to production facilities in Qatar continues to disrupt contracted cargoes.

items.title: UK Revives Stalled North Sea Natural Gas Project as Energy Supply Fears Grow
items.summary: The UK government has cleared natural gas production to start from the stalled Jackdaw field in the North Sea off the coast of Scotland as Europe confronts a tight market and supply shortages caused by the Iran war heading into winter.
